name: First Aid
description: Revive a downed ally out of combat at any rank (20% HP + 2% per rank); from rank 5 also in combat as a weight-1,000 action at 30%; bandage Bleed. Warden and Mender +2 at start.

mastery.text: Rank 10 is the line in the description; the per-rank numbers live in tuning.json (skills.fieldSkills).
